timingInterpretation.clock: One document performance clock; no peer-clock subtraction.
timingInterpretation.native: Wall time through native work, GL submission and audio; not CPU thread time or GPU completion.
timingInterpretation.presentation: Counter changes observed at callback exit; not GPU completion or display scanout.
timingInterpretation.outsideCallbacks: Time outside the observed native callbacks may contain other tasks, normal frame scheduling or process descheduling; no cause is assigned.
timingInterpretation.waits: Request-to-entry, timestamp-to-entry and previous-exit-to-entry overlap; never add them to the gap partition.
timingInterpretation.edges: The first row initializes counters, so the start segment may include an unrecognized first presentation/frontier event. End segments are censored at the configured end.
timingInterpretation.clipped: Native/shell/observer totals cover complete callbacks only; a callback crossing the window edge contributes its overlap separately.
timingInterpretation.timers: Same-page injected send timers overlapping the gap; a late delivery may occur after the gap. Timing overlap does not establish causality.
timingInterpretation.phases: Native profile bins may nest (for example exactTick contains update/draw); they are context, not additive components.

legacyHandshakeEvidence.interpretation: The old sender delay shim sent READY ahead of HELLO; the peer observed that order and rejected startup. This specific packet-order evidence does not assign a cause to measured performance tails.

geometry.compilerVersion: emcc (Emscripten gcc/clang-like replacement + linker emulating GNU ld) 6.0.9-git (4e4223852a0835923411059a3929907d7df1232e)

outcome.interpretation: The candidate passes native/Replay/playfield correctness but fails this 100 ms performance gate. One paired desktop run does not establish a causal performance regression, a speedup, 60 FPS, or general stability.

independentAudit.method: Independent Python recomputation from preserved receipt, peer, Replay and RGBA files; no game run, browser run, test rerun or source change.

findings.performanceConclusion: The baseline passes the unchanged 100 ms gate once; the Draw candidate fails it on both seats. Native P95 also rises from 9.3/8.2 to 10.7/8.7 ms in this pair. This does not establish a drawing speedup or prove that the code change caused the slower run.
findings.scopeLimit: No GPU completion clock, CPU thread-time trace, fixed identical input workload, or complete world body dump was collected. Outside-callback time is not assigned to browser, GPU, OS or game code.
